scope: Generic transient, BDOS, CCP-visible and processor-baseline commitments without direct BIOS conformance.
gate: Every applicable generic REQUIRED case in the declared baseline scope PASS; none BLOCKED; profile and optional cases are excluded unless claimed.
allowed_claim: CP/M 2.2 baseline compatible for the declared environment.

scope: BASELINE plus documented BDOS and BIOS public interfaces selected by the claim.
gate: BASELINE passes and every applicable interface REQUIRED case passes.
allowed_claim: CP/M 2.2 interface compatible for the declared interfaces.

scope: INTERFACE plus boot, CCP, BIOS-visible, disk-structure, recovery and selected generic ecosystem commitments.
gate: All applicable generic REQUIRED cases across the frozen inventory pass; none are blocked.
allowed_claim: Full-system CP/M 2.2 compatible for the declared hardware environment.

scope: Any base level plus one or more explicitly named profiles.
gate: Underlying base level passes and every PROFILE REQUIRED case for each selected profile passes.
allowed_claim: The underlying level plus the exact named profile list.

gate: The underlying base level passes and claimed OPTIONAL cases pass without weakening baseline behavior.
allowed_claim: Optional feature support, never a substitute for base certification.

gate: No certification gate; all PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, ERROR and NOT_APPLICABLE results are reported.
allowed_claim: Development status only; no compatibility certification.
